entities.name: Las Huelgas Codex
entities.label: Evidence
entities.summary: The Codex Las Huelgas is a music manuscript or codex from c. 1300 which originated in and has remained in the Cistercian convent of Santa María la Real de Las Huelgas in Burgos, in northern Spain. The convent was a wealthy one which had connections with the royal family of Castile. Las Huelgas Codex is a manuscript from Europe. Classified as Tier A (Primary Source) evidence. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
